entries.headline: Nitrogen-Doped Lutetium Hydride Under Review
entries.information: Extensive independent laboratory replications evaluate high-pressure hydride phase diagrams and superconducting magnetic susceptibility thresholds.
entries.source: Nature & Physical Review B Peer Reviews

entries.headline: Direct Electrochemical CO2 Reduction to C2+ Products via Bimetallic Cu-Ag Interfaces
entries.information: Nanostructured tandem catalyst achieving >85% Faradaic efficiency toward ethylene and ethanol using zero-gap membrane electrode assemblies.
entries.source: Journal of the American Chemical Society (JACS)

entries.headline: Overall Pure Water Splitting Using Covalent Organic Frameworks (COFs)
entries.information: Fully conjugated crystalline sp2 carbon-linked COF photocatalyst achieving overall water splitting without sacrificial reagents under visible light.

entries.headline: Autonomous Atmospheric Water Harvesting in Arid Climates Using Aluminum MOF-303
entries.information: Field deployment of customized metal-organic framework MOF-303 yielding >1.3 liters of pure drinking water per kilogram MOF daily at <20% relative humidity.
